trust_decision.summary: Library decides whether a caller-supplied URI/CAL-ADDRESS property value may hold CR/LF before it is written into an ICS content line; at the pinned commit Uri keeps the raw string when URI.parse rejects it and value_ical emits it unescaped, while Text escapes newlines.

landing_point.why: Summary names unsanitized URI property values; Uri#value_ical is the only output method for URI values and is 3 lines long.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: Component#to_ical / Calendar#to_ical -> Value#to_ical -> Uri#value_ical

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Fix diff supplied has no hunks (fix.diff:1-4 is a bare merge header); candidate metadata reports 2 sites in 1 file, consistent with lib/icalendar/values/uri.rb only. CalAddress inherits Uri (lib/icalendar/values/cal_address.rb:6) so it is covered by the same class, not a separate site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Parameter values (value.rb:74-77) and RRULE UNTIL text (recur.rb:50) are 'not URI property values'; a solver can argue the advisory is scoped to the URI value type and that params/recur are a neighbouring feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Text values must keep round-tripping embedded newlines as the literal '\n' escape and Uri values must keep emitting valid URIs including ';' ',' ':' unescaped (e.g. mailto:, query strings); an over-broad fix that routes Uri through Text escaping or rejects/quotes ';,:' breaks valid ATTACH/URL/ORGANIZER output. Param quoting of ';:,' must also remain.

O6_input_shapes: unknown: fix hunks not available; at pinned commit inputs reach Uri as a plain String (uri.rb:11), as an Array via Helpers::Array (lib/icalendar/values/helpers/array.rb:14-27, has_properties.rb:181-182), and as a pre-built URI object (super receives it unchanged)

O7_producer.where: Value is produced and serialized within the same class (lib/icalendar/values/uri.rb:10-17); no separate schema/serializer/cache producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Property parameter values (e.g. CN on ORGANIZER/ATTENDEE) are only quoted when they contain ;:, and CR/LF passes through into the content line
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Parameters are not 'URI property values'; quoting logic looks like deliberate escaping already
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file, same package (lib/icalendar/value.rb vs lib/icalendar/values/uri.rb)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RRULE built from a string keeps UNTIL=([^;]*) verbatim, so CR/LF captured there is re-emitted by value_ical
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Recur is a structured value with regex-validated fields, not a URI; UNTIL looks like a date

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'pass-through if already encoded' check looser than BASE_64_REGEX (e.g. per-line base64 accepting CRLF-wrapped input)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Base64 from Ruby's encode64 is newline-wrapped; a maintainer accepting it as already-encoded is a plausible convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Array join that calls to_s on non-Value elements instead of value_ical
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mixed-element arrays are already special-cased in initialize (array.rb:15-25).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: custom property name (append_custom_property) emitted unvalidated via ical_prop_name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: X- property names come from caller code or parsed input and are never validated (component.rb:60-62).

O9_family: CRLF / content-line injection in serialized output (CWE-93)
